review_text: The earbuds sound good, but they slowly work loose when I run and I have to push them back in.
I ran a 10K with the medium tips and they stayed secure the entire time.
The left earbud falls out during burpees even after trying every included tip.
Comfortable for walking, but sweat makes the buds slip during faster workouts.
The wing tips keep them stable for cycling and treadmill sessions.
After about forty minutes the housing presses against my ear and becomes painful.
Battery dropped from full to empty in under four hours with noise cancelling on.
Battery lasted through a full workday and my evening commute.
The charging case is bulky and does not fit comfortably in a jeans pocket.
The compact case is easy to carry and the battery indicator is useful.
People on calls say my voice sounds distant when there is wind outside.
Call quality is clear in a quiet office, but I have not tested it outdoors.
Bluetooth cuts out for a second whenever my phone is in my back pocket.
Connection has been stable across my apartment and pairing was immediate.
The touch control pauses music whenever I adjust the fit.
Controls are responsive once you learn where to tap.
The app offers only three equalizer presets and none reduce the heavy bass enough.
The equalizer is simple and the vocal preset works well for podcasts.
One earbud stopped charging because the case contacts did not line up reliably.
The magnets pull both buds into the charging position every time.
Noise cancelling reduces the low hum but voices still come through clearly.
ANC handles train noise better than I expected at this price.
There is no way to disable the loud voice prompts, which is annoying at night.
Voice prompts are brief and not distracting for me.
The smallest ear tips are still too large for my ears.
Four tip sizes made it easy to get a good seal for small ears.
The glossy case picked up scratches during the first week.
The matte case still looks new after a month in my gym bag.
Audio is balanced, although the maximum volume is lower than my old pair.
Sound is detailed enough for workouts and the volume range is comfortable.
